site_description: Christopher John Malanchen is a film and television editor based in Toronto, Canada. Christopher John Malanchen also co-owns Night Gallery Productions, a Toronto based film and television production company founded in 2025 by Christopher Malanchen & Ivana Sabaj.
name: Christopher John Malanchen
subtitle: Editor: Film & Television
bio_paragraphs: I am a professional film and television editor based in Toronto, Canada. As a freelance editor I work in several genres, including television, documentaries, short and feature films.
I enjoy collaborating with storytellers who have a unique voice and a passion for crafting captivating narratives.
credentials: DGC, Canadian Film Centre Editor Alumni
